title: Rust parity: Rust missing DatagramChannel abstraction
description: Python has DatagramChannel ABC with send_datagram(priority, check_congestion). Rust sends direct without abstraction layer. Fix: add DatagramChannel trait for uniform priority propagation.
close_reason: Added DatagramChannel trait in rust/lichen-core/src/transport.rs with send_datagram, congestion_level, retry_after_ms, congestion_state, and check_congestion_for methods. Includes CongestionError struct and check_congestion_allows function. All tests pass.
